acceptanceCriteria: Compare full Model and sequence for mixed multi-record creation/growth/shrink batches at every publication prefix, with and without barrier; prove rollback after a later-prefix capacity refusal.
Compare full Model and sequence refusals for same-batch and cross-batch case-fold collisions and the exact ticket-count boundary, proving invalidation after refusal.
body: Review of V1-0436 diff 3337f5f6..d8e32a676 found coverage gaps, not confirmed implementation defects. import_capacity_test.go:33-45 uses one BF-1 record per batch for every prefix oracle. SequenceBatchGrowth also uses one record; the multi-record benchmark does not compare prefixes. import_sequence_test.go:116 refusal table omits the new hand-maintained case-fold and MaxTicketsPerQueue checks at import_sequence.go:177-197. These replace full ticket.NewInventory checks. Full transaction suite and focused CALV0018|CTSV0003 tests pass; installed Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.523. Add differential tests and retain failing-control evidence.
title: CAL-V0-018 differential tests omit mixed batches and incremental inventory refusal boundaries
